qualifier: end resection, end joining and ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break repair by resection, end joining and PARylation
rationale: All members concern sensing, processing and repair of DNA double-strand breaks (HR, NHEJ, alt-EJ/MMEJ, SSA, BRCA1/2-PALB2 defects) and the PARylation that regulates it, whereas confusables centre on strand invasion, interstrand cross-link repair or replication-stress responses.

qualifier: myeloid differentiation and colony-stimulating factor production
name: Bone marrow homeostasis, myeloid differentiation and CSF production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow development, cell proliferation/apoptosis and cell-number homeostasis plus macrophage/dendritic differentiation and G-CSF/M-CSF production, distinguishing it from confusables built on CSF receptor signaling, granulopoiesis, HSC maintenance or RUNX transcription.

qualifier: phosphatidylethanolamine acyl-chain remodeling
name: Phosphatidylethanolamine remodeling within glycerophospholipid metabolism
rationale: All three members concern glycerophospholipid metabolism focused on PE acyl-chain remodeling, unlike confusables about PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or eicosanoid metabolism.

qualifier: Trk receptors and p75NTR pro-survival branches
name: Neurotrophin Trk and p75NTR pro-survival signaling
rationale: Members are NGF/BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 signaling through TrkA/B/C to Ras, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, CREB plus p75NTR survival and NF-kB, whereas confusables carry p75NTR/dependence-receptor death signaling or generic MAPK cascades.

qualifier: osteoclast regulation and insulin-like growth factor response
name: Osteoclast-driven bone remodeling and insulin-like growth factor response
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption, mineralization and chondrocyte development together with IGF and peptide responses, distinguishing it from osteoblast/Wnt- or tooth-mineralization-centred confusables.

qualifier: including GPER1 and estrous cycle
name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling, including GPER1
rationale: All members concern estrogen/estradiol and progesterone responses and receptor signaling (nuclear and GPER1) and the estrous cycle, while confusables add androgen receptor or hallmark estrogen-response signatures.

qualifier: UV-A and blue light
name: Cellular response to ultraviolet and blue light
rationale: Members are UV-A/UV-B and UV-response signatures plus blue light (and phorbol ester), distinguished from confusables by UV-A and blue-light responses rather than NF-kB, liver or MITF programmes.

qualifier: protein gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K/menaquinone metabolism and the vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, propeptide removal and ER-Golgi transport of carboxylated precursors, unlike confusables on quinone/sterol synthesis, other vitamins or coagulation.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and organelle contact-site lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping and ER-organelle contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation/fusion, membrane tethering to mitochondria and plasma membrane (incl. Miro GTPases) and intermembrane PI/PC/cholesterol transfer, whereas confusables emphasize Golgi vesicle traffic, phospholipid flipping or PIP synthesis at other membranes.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation/dedifferentiation and blood vessel remodeling, distinguishing it from cardiac-muscle and endothelial-centred confusables.

qualifier: amyloid-beta clearance and fibril formation
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members combine microglial proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity with amyloid-beta clearance, amyloid fibril formation and apoptotic cell clearance, whereas confusables lack either the microglial or the amyloid-clearance side.

qualifier: phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Adenine nucleotide interconversion and phosphocreatine energy shuttle
rationale: Members cover nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, the latter two separating it from GTP, NAD or nucleoside-transport confusables.

qualifier: p75NTR and dependence receptors
name: Neurotrophin p75NTR and dependence receptor death signaling
rationale: Members are NGF/proNGF production and binding to p75NTR with NADE, NRAGE-JNK and ceramide death signaling plus ligand-less dependence-receptor caspase activation, distinguishing it from Trk survival or axon-regeneration confusables.

qualifier: bacterial agglutination and cytolysis
name: Mucosal antibacterial defense via agglutination and cytolysis
rationale: Members concern host defense at mucosal epithelia: bacterial attachment, agglutination and cytolysis of microbes, unlike confusables centred on antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration or neutrophil killing.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelial cells and mucociliary clearance
name: Multiciliated epithelium motile cilium assembly and mucociliary clearance
rationale: Members cover multiciliogenesis transcription, de novo centriole/basal body formation, dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance, whereas confusables concern sperm flagella, left-right asymmetry or tubulin modification.

qualifier: general, not amino-acid specific
name: General L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three members are generic (obsolete) L-/alpha-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms, unlike confusables naming specific amino acids such as tyrosine, phenylalanine or proline.

qualifier: definitive endoderm, lateral plate mesoderm and primitive gut
name: Gastrulation into endoderm, lateral mesoderm and primitive gut
rationale: Members cover primitive streak and gastrulation, definitive endoderm specification, lateral plate mesoderm and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on mesoderm migration, EMT or pluripotency factors.

qualifier: canonical NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 activation via TLR, TRIF and inflammasome
name: Toll-like receptor TAK1 signaling to canonical NF-kappaB and JNK
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF/IRAK-TRAF6 activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical NF-kB, JNK and p38, plus inflammasome/ALPK1 inputs, whereas confusables cover non-canonical NF-kB, TNFR1 or NOD signaling.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily, RND and atypical Rho GTPases
name: CDC42, RND and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 GTPase cycles with formin/IQGAP effectors and Rac antagonism, distinguishing it from RHOA/B/C- or RAC-centred confusables.

qualifier: lysine methylation/demethylation, deacetylation and CHD remodelers
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases/demethylases, HDACs, NuRD/CHD/ChAHP remodelers and X inactivation, unlike confusables on BAF complexes, DNA methylation/PRC2 or arginine methylation.

qualifier: neuron versus glia fate, midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Neuronal versus glial differentiation, including midbrain dopaminergic neurons
rationale: Members regulate neuron, astrocyte and oligodendrocyte differentiation and midbrain/cerebellar progenitor proliferation incl. dopaminergic neurons, whereas confusables are forebrain progenitor division or Schwann/myelination themes.

qualifier: resting and activated states
name: Dendritic cell surface signatures, resting and activated
rationale: Members are resting, LPS-activated and general DC surface and enrichment signatures, distinguishing it from B cell and monocyte surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: CDC42-related GTPases with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: CDC42-related Rho GTPase cycles and formin/IQGAP effectors
rationale: Members are the CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV and RHOD cycles plus formin and IQGAP activation, unlike confusables dominated by RHOA/B/C/G or RND GTPases.

qualifier: planar cell polarity, convergent extension and Wnt secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP signaling, convergent extension and Wnt secretion
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity, Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, convergent extension and Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion, while confusables centre on hedgehog, axial mesoderm/neural plate patterning or left-right asymmetry.

qualifier: cytokinesis and nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation
name: Cytokinesis and mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation
rationale: Members cover contractile ring, furrow, midbody abscission and nuclear lamina/membrane disassembly, ESCRT sealing and reassembly, distinguishing it from chromosome condensation/cohesion or spindle-checkpoint confusables.
